subject: Application: Junior Designer/Estimator (Cranbourne) – Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I saw your SEEK advert for Junior Designer/Estimator in Cranbourne (job 95023805), open to a graduate engineer building layout and estimating skills.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2014 to 2019). In 2019 to 2020 I worked as field engineer and project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and Australian driver's licence with transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. Available for site, regional and FIFO work.

The role asks for racking layouts, take-offs and quotations. My estimating is coursework only, and my CAD is academic rather than production racking software. Happy to learn those tools on the job if that works.

I have attached my resume and cover letter.
Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
